position.name: Wellness Coordinator - Adolescent Mental Health

streetAddress.location: 4611 Johnson Rd, Coconut Creek, FL 33073, USA

position.description:
Wellness Coordinator

On Site | Coconut Creek, FL | Part-Time | 3pm-8pm

About the Role
You are the operational backbone of the AWA program environment. You ensure the day-to-day experience for adolescent clients is safe, structured, and therapeutically consistent — from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. This role is hands-on, fast-paced, and client-facing, requiring calm under pressure and genuine investment in the teens you serve.
Backgrounds that translate well: Youth Work · Behavioral Health · Education · Case Management · Community Services

What You'll Do

  • Supervise adolescent clients ages 13–17 during sessions, transitions, breaks, and unstructured time
  • Monitor and maintain program safety; respond to escalated behavior using trauma-informed and crisis protocols
  • Support clinicians in maintaining therapeutic schedules and program flow
  • Greet and assist families at drop-off and pick-up with professionalism and warmth
  • Manage front desk responsibilities including phones, attendance, and sign-in/out
  • Complete accurate, same-day documentation including wellness check-ins and incident reports
  • Escalate safety concerns, disclosures, and behavioral flags to the clinical team immediately and appropriately
  • Support program operations with light administrative and organizational tasks

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience working with adolescents in a school, clinical, camp, or community setting
  • Demonstrated ability to de-escalate, regulate, and maintain structure without power struggles
  • Strong documentation and incident reporting skills
  • Bilingual required: English and Spanish
  • Emotionally regulated, professional, and consistent under pressure
  • Understands the limits of a non-clinical role — escalates appropriately, never makes independent clinical decisions

Preferred

  • Students or recent graduates in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or related fields strongly encouraged to apply
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience considered

AWA is an adolescent mental health organization operating PHP and IOP programs in South Florida. We exist to serve teens and families at their most critical moments — and this role is at the center of that work every day.

Cover Letter

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Wellness Coordinator position. As a bilingual English and Spanish speaker currently pursuing my Master’s degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling, I am eager to combine my healthcare experience with my passion for supporting adolescents in a therapeutic setting.

My background as an Animal Technician/Veterinary Nurse taught me how to remain calm during emergencies, recognize changes in behavior, communicate compassionately with families during stressful situations, maintain accurate documentation, and work collaboratively with medical professionals. These experiences strengthened my ability to stay organized, think critically under pressure, and provide compassionate care while maintaining a safe environment.

In addition to my healthcare experience, my graduate studies have provided me with a strong foundation in counseling ethics, adolescent development, trauma-informed care, multicultural counseling, and crisis intervention. I am eager to apply these skills while continuing to learn from experienced clinicians.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it allows me to support adolescents in a structured and therapeutic environment while contributing to their safety and well-being. I am confident that my compassion, professionalism, bilingual communication skills, and dedication to helping others would make me a valuable member of your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my education and healthcare experience align with your team’s mission.

Sincerely,

Sarah Arias

Samantha Reilly
